_comment: Pterodactyl egg — Velocity proxy. Put SecureAuthVelocity-*.jar in /plugins.
name: Velocity SecureAuth
author: tienday
description: Velocity 3.3/3.4 proxy for SecureAuth companion. Java 17+. Upload SecureAuthVelocity jar to plugins/.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
cd /mnt/server
VEL_VERSION="${VEL_VERSION:-3.4.0-SNAPSHOT}"
echo "Download Velocity manually if API changes; placeholder velocity.jar"
# Official: https://fill.papermc.io/ or papermc velocity
curl -fsSL -o velocity.jar "https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/3.4.0-SNAPSHOT/builds/$(curl -fsSL https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/3.4.0-SNAPSHOT | grep -o '"builds":\[[0-9,]*\]' | grep -o '[0-9]*' | tail -1)/downloads/velocity-3.4.0-SNAPSHOT-$(curl -fsSL https://api.papermc.io/v2/projects/velocity/versions/3.4.0-SNAPSHOT | grep -o '"builds":\[[0-9,]*\]' | grep -o '[0-9]*' | tail -1).jar" || true
mkdir -p plugins
echo "Upload SecureAuthVelocity-*.jar to plugins/"
